calculation.description: One-day-lagged, risk-scaled three-day reversal of market-residual returns, activated only when cross-asset daily dispersion is unusually high. Market beta and volatility use trailing data only.

decay.note: Admission horizon is next-day forward return; longer-horizon decay not tested in this cycle.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and stronger in 2028-2029; 2029 full-year IC 0.08328 and ICIR 0.30035, while 2029-07-01 onward IC 0.04791 and ICIR 0.13970. Small cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
